items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And I had Sonny White playing piano. ... I think Sonny White went up there with me.

ctx.x: Around '39, or something like that. And then in '38, the fall of '38, I went and played back with Cab Calloway in Chu's place for about three or four weeks while he had a vacation at the Cotton Club Downtown. I played tenor then.

And then I -- after the Nemo Club then I had this small group's book, Benny Carter and Maxine went to Boston and they used my book. There was Benny Carter and Al Gibson and myself. Benny was playing trumpet and alto. And I was playing clarinet and Al Gibson and Sonny White on piano. And I don't remember who the drummer was.
